lowCentralClearance.note: Visual design clearance; no game collider or camera collision test was performed.

structure.reuse: Each season is a named group. Existing vertices use world coordinates; subtract that season's Z origin in meters when rebuilding a local Three.js module. Foliage overlaps segment ends naturally by up to approximately 0.5 m.

leafGeometry.shape: Curved lanceolate surface with raised midrib; not a triangle plane
leafGeometry.distribution: Random positions on 17 longitudinal curved vine strands, with individually varied length, width and tilt
leafGeometry.reproductionNote: Scene placement used Spline rand(); parameters reproduce the design, not identical random placement.

flowers.connection: Thin pedicels join flower clusters to the vine canopy
flowers.distribution: Irregular positions along the 17 vine strands; no regular hanging ornament grid

threeJsRecommendations.note: Season exposure multipliers and transition interpolation are integration suggestions, not implemented runtime behavior. Calibrate in the game's renderer.
